description: Exact age from a birth date to a target date, broken into years, months, and days, plus total days lived, total hours lived, the weekday of birth, and days until the next birthday. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive age calculator calculator.

birth_date.description: Date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format.

target_date.description: Date to calculate the age as of, in YYYY-MM-DD format. If omitted, today is used, matching the page.

name: calculate_age
